x: A great debt of gratitude is due to our President, Charlie Jones, and Tom Carter for the tremendous work they did, in which they were assisted by other Club Honorary Coaches in Frank Simmons (who never spared himself for a second) Mike Lyons, Bill Couzens, and to the specialist demonstrators who gave of their time.

Your instructor is Mike Lyons who would like to see more members attending these enjoyable gatherings. Incidently photographs of our lads in action were published in the December issue of "Man's World" magazine.
